text: 金十数据7月15日讯，欧洲央行管委会成员、意大利央行行长帕内塔周三表示，即便在地缘政治局势充满不确定性的背景下，欧洲央行的货币政策也必须保持审慎，以确保通胀预期保持稳定。 他称：“在考虑未来决策时，欧洲央行管理委员会将仔细评估能源市场状况，以及经济形势、工资水平和商品及服务价格的走势。我们的目标是牢牢锚定通胀预期，限制各类冲击带来的间接影响及第二轮效应。”
text_en: GOLDEN TEN DATA July 15 - European Central Bank Governing Council member and Bank of Italy Governor Panetta said Wednesday that even against a backdrop of geopolitical uncertainty, the ECB's monetary policy must remain prudent to ensure inflation expectations stay stable. He stated: 'When considering future decisions, the ECB Governing Council will carefully assess energy market conditions, as well as economic conditions, wage levels, and price trends for goods and services. Our goal is to firmly anchor inflation expectations and limit indirect effects and second-round effects from various shocks.'
